title: Task
description: A work unit within a phase.

id.description: Task identifier (e.g., TASK-001). A split task's parts carry a letter suffix: TASK-001a, TASK-001b.

type.description: Task type determining the specialist role.

archetype.description: Archetype identifier governing the task's step sequence.

dependsOn.description: Tasks that must complete before this one can start. Every id must name a task that exists; `nit validate --schema task` resolves them, and `nit deps` builds the graph from this field. Recording a dependency in prose instead leaves it invisible to both.

acceptanceCriteria.description: List of acceptance criteria for the task.
